## Summary

<!-- What does this PR change and why? -->

## Type of change

- [ ] feat — new feature
- [ ] fix — bug fix
- [ ] docs — documentation only

> PR title must follow Conventional Commits (e.g. `feat: add X`).

## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm lint` passes
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passes
- [ ] `pnpm test:coverage` passes (≥ 80%)
- [ ] `pnpm build` passes
- [ ] Added/updated tests for the change
